note: FOR item IN heard orders selects each order group. Take a fresh sheet, interpret that item, deposit it, and return to the register inside every iteration.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
FOR item IN heard orders
  TAKE UP
  IF tea IN item
    ITEM tea
  ELSE
    ITEM coffee
  END
  IF sugar IN item
    IF negation IN item
      WRITE 0 sugar
    ELSE
      WRITE 1 sugar
    END
  END
  MOVE RIGHT 1
  DEPOSIT RIGHT
  MOVE LEFT 1
END
JUMP listen
